Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2023-1389, a high-severity unauthenticated command injection and remote code execution vulnerability in TP-Link Archer AX21 (AX1800) router's web management API
Builds a DDoS botnet for rent to launch attacks on websites and services
Kills processes of competitor botnets and older versions of itself
Uses a wiper to disable device reboot/shutdown commands to prevent device restarts
Scans for public IPs with open ports 80 or 8080 to send exploitation requests and execute remote shell scripts
Uses various TCP and UDP flood DDoS attack methods similar to Mirai
Some samples use other vulnerabilities and an ADB (Android Debug Bridge) port (TCP/5555) for propagation
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2023-1389 vulnerability via open HTTP ports (80, 8080)
Potential exploitation of open ADB port (TCP/5555)
